name: Jacob Prince-Bieker
bio: Jacob Prince-Bieker is one of the most active contributors to Open Climate Fix's open source work on GitHub, with 332 contributions to skillful_nowcasting, graph_weather. Their public GitHub profile reads: “ML Researcher. Previously Open Climate Fix, BrightBand, Jua, SecondLaw, VIDA. Interested in  applications of AI to large-scale datasets, especially for weather”.
